items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang scandal raises questions for AI leaders
items.summary: Deirdre Bosa Live host Deirdre Bosa examines the developing controversy surrounding Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang amid allegations involving a woman suspected of passing information to Beijing. Bosa is joined by Sierra CEO and co-founder and OpenAI Chairman Bret Taylor, alongside Sierra co-founder Clay Bavor, to discuss the potential fallout for Nvidia, the importance of trust in AI leadership, and what the controversy could mean for the broader AI ecosystem.
